title: Guest Stories
lede: Find out more about our guests experience. Their photos, their words.

stories.shortQuote: “They let us plan a sailing trip with our eyes closed.”
stories.name: Clémence
stories.fullQuote: “I highly recommend Eagle Ray. They let us plan a sailing trip with our eyes closed when it came to the organization. The team is responsive and very professional. They know exactly what they're doing, and it makes everything easy. Roberto, our skipper, put us at ease and made us feel completely safe. He was really great.”

stories.shortQuote: “Not a spectator, but part of how the boat ran.”
stories.name: Gabriel
stories.fullQuote: “What stood out was how close the crew was to us. I loved the long talks around the table after meals, learning to sail, and that real feeling of not being a spectator but actually part of how the boat ran. The human side is, without a doubt, Eagle Ray's biggest asset and what sets it apart.”
